# BestBuyIncentives

> Best Buy Incentives helps salespeople close more contracts with powerful travel-incentive certificates — lifting close rates without cutting price. Operated by Karl Kramer & Company, Inc. (Bellmore, NY), a sales-growth company trusted since 1992.

BestBuyIncentives provides premium travel-incentive certificate programs that high-ticket sales teams use as a closing tool. Instead of discounting to win a deal, a rep offers the buyer a vacation experience — protecting margin while lifting close rates (reported at +37% on average across 1,200+ sales teams). Programs are used across auto dealerships, jewelers, furniture retailers, home-improvement, flooring, mattress, luxury retail, and B2B sales organizations. The company handles all travel redemption and support; the client's team never touches logistics.
